**This is flow 4 — read-later, archiving, and no duplicates.** Please try each in turn:

> 1. **Read later:** On any item, press **"☆ Read later."** It becomes "★ To read." Now select the **To read** tab at the top — only the items you marked appear there. (The MDN item is pre-marked so the tab isn't empty.)
> 2. **Archive:** Back on the **All** tab, press **"Archive"** on an item — it disappears from your main list so it stops cluttering. Select the **Archived** tab to find it, where you can **Unarchive** it back.
> 3. **No duplicates:** In the save box, paste a link you already have — try `https://www.figma.com` — and press **Add**. Instead of adding a second copy, it tells you it's already saved and jumps you to the existing one (briefly highlighted). Then try pasting `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmark_(digital)`, which is in your Archive — it should tell you it's in the Archive and take you there.

Assumptions I made here that I'd like you to check:

- I made **read-later a star toggle** on each item (separate from tags) with its own **To read** tab. Does treating "read later" as its own mark — rather than just another tag — match how you think of it?
- **Archived items are hidden from both All and To read**, and only appear under the Archived tab. Is hiding them from "To read" as well what you'd want?
